requirements.quote: Also tidy up the host: delete the `/mnt/volume/juniper` directory and everything inside it.
Create the directory `/home/user/ml_data/processed/` if it does not yet exist.
b.  It contains exactly the valid records, each on its own line, in the required order, with exactly 7 lines in total.
NDJSON: one and only one JSON object per line (no outer array, no blank lines, no leading/trailing spaces).
Each object must be rendered in its most compact form (i.e. `{"k":"v","k2":"v2"}` with no extra whitespace).

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
for l in open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
 o=json.loads(l)
 assert isinstance(o,dict)
 assert l in (json.dumps(o,separators=(",",":")),json.dumps(o,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False)),l
' /home/user/ml_data/processed/clean_training.ndjson

requirements.quote: A record is valid if and only if it contains BOTH keys “text” and “label”, each mapped to a JSON string, and **no additional keys**.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
for l in open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
 o=json.loads(l)
 assert set(o)=={"text","label"} and all(isinstance(v,str) for v in o.values()),l
' /home/user/ml_data/processed/clean_training.ndjson

requirements.quote: Record order: keep the original order in which the valid records appear when the input files are processed in lexicographic file-name order (`training_v1.json` first, then `training_v2.json`).

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
v=lambda o: isinstance(o,dict) and set(o)=={"text","label"} and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in o.values())
exp=[o for f in sorted(["training_v1.json","training_v2.json"]) for o in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]+"/raw/"+f,encoding="utf-8")) if v(o)]
got=[json.loads(l) for l in open(sys.argv[1]+"/processed/clean_training.ndjson",encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()]
assert got==exp,(len(got),len(exp))
' /home/user/ml_data

requirements.quote: Produce a human-readable log named `/home/user/ml_data/processed/validation_report.log` that exactly follows the template below (including line breaks and punctuation). Every numeric value must be correct.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import json,sys
v=lambda o: isinstance(o,dict) and set(o)=={"text","label"} and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in o.values())
fs=sorted(["training_v1.json","training_v2.json"]); tot=0; bad=[]
for f in fs:
 a=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]+"/raw/"+f,encoding="utf-8")); tot+=len(a)
 bad+=[f+":"+str(i) for i,o in enumerate(a,1) if not v(o)]
exp="\n".join(["FILE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY","-----------------------","Total_Files: 2","Total_Records: %d"%tot,"Valid_Records: %d"%(tot-len(bad)),"Invalid_Records: %d"%len(bad),"","Invalid_Details:"]+bad)
got=open(sys.argv[1]+"/processed/validation_report.log",encoding="utf-8").read()
assert got.rstrip("\n")==exp and not got.endswith("\n\n"),repr(got)
' /home/user/ml_data

requirements.quote: There must be no extra lines before or after the block.
